.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/create/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> [content] to scaffold the type, where <id> is the type's identifier and the optional [content] is the body to place inside the type definition.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/list/ste.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] where searchTerm is an optional string to filter type ids.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/update/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> <change-request> to verify the type identified by `<id>` exists before proceeding with the update.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/delete/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to delete the type identified by `id`.
Run {{script}} <id>, passing the same type id used for the delete action, to print every existing reference to that type as `[file path]:[line number]` lines.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/evaluate.instruction: Run `{{script}} <id>` where `<id>` is the type's identifier (e.g. `user`), to evaluate the corresponding type file against the rules.

create.text: Scaffolds a new type file at src/types/{Name}.type.ts given a type id and optional initial definition, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists type artifacts under src/types matching an optional search term, printing each as id: file path.

update.text: Modifies an existing type at src/types/{name}.type.ts to satisfy a given change request, erroring if the type does not exist.

delete.text: Deletes a type artifact by id from src/types, then finds, prints, and removes all dangling references to it in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a type artifact's file path, single top-level definition, strict shape, and domain-only scope comply with the type rules, given a type id.
